programs.title: Power & S2 - "Matt Oehrlein"
programs.desc: Matt Oehrlein loves giant robots, so he and his partner Gui Cavalcanti set out to start a firm that builds giant fighting robots, called Megabots.

programs.title: Power & S2 - "Rainer Farraq"
programs.desc: Rainer Farraq is an Austrian engineer who invented the TrixyFormer: An electric driven, enclosed motorcycle, which can be docked into many different vehicles.

programs.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Dr. Rainer Dolch"
programs.desc: Dr. Rainer Dolch is an ecologist who has been living and researching in Madagascar for almost 30 years.

programs.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Jonathan Franzen"
programs.desc: Jonathan Franzen, the bestselling author and enthusiastic birdwatcher not only familiarizes us with the birdlife, but also discusses the far-reaching consequences of the drastic decline in birds on a global scale and what we can do to save them.

programs.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Lydia Moecklinghoff"
programs.desc: Lydia Möcklinghoff, a renowned anteater researcher, has dedicated her life to the protection and study of these fascinating creatures.

programs.title: Wildlife Heroes S1 - "Maria Diekmann"
programs.desc: The Californian Maria Diekmann founded the Rare and Endangered Species Trust, REST in short, to provide care for injured and endangered animals.
